# Wandering Cities

> City travel guides and two-host podcast episodes about cities and towns in the Netherlands (Belgium coming soon), in 6 languages (English, German, Dutch, French, Spanish, Italian). One city per episode: how it came to be, the landmarks worth seeing, the food worth trying.

Episodes, texts and transcripts are made with AI from cited sources (Wikipedia, Wikivoyage and official tourism, heritage and museum websites) and checked against those sources. The conversation and voices are AI-generated.

Currently 72 cities, 430 episodes, 69 city maps. Each city has:
- a start screen: /<country>/<city>/
- the podcast episode in every published language, with description and (mostly) transcript: /<country>/<city>/podcast/
- a map of its highlights with photos and directions (most cities): /<country>/<city>/map/
- phrases, customs and food for visitors, per country: /<country>/phrases/, /<country>/customs/, /<country>/food/
